body:
Solid PR. The auth refactor reads cleanly and the new tests cover the happy path. One token-logging issue to fix before merge.

_2 findings dropped (forbidden severity×type combo)._

## Findings outside the diff

- _✨ polish_ | _🟣 pre_existing_: [`src/api/auth.py:5`](https://github.com/example/example/blob/0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567/src/api/auth.py#L5)

  **One-line description of what `auth` owns vs `session`.**

  - The module docstring stops at the function name list
  - A reader hits the names without knowing the boundary
  - One line under the docstring lays out the seam

---

🧙 _Even the smallest diff can change the course of the codebase._ · [youshallnotmerge](https://github.com/apps/youshallnotmerge)

comments.body:
_🐛 bug_ | _🔴 important_

**Drop `session.token` from the warning log.** It writes the token in plaintext on the warning branch; redact before emit.

_🔧 refactor_ | _🟡 nit_

**Split `parse_and_persist` into two functions.**

- Parses, validates, and persists in one call
- Splitting makes failure modes orthogonal
- Each function then tests in isolation
